answer: Time-delayed signal echoes defend the canyon against clone floods. Each identity must send cryptographic signals at random, the lantern-verified intervals between them measured by a distant enclave, and the signal propagates through the canyon to be checked. When one infrastructure's fleet emits matching intervals, a collision registers and both identities freeze, their shared bond of 18,000 POA burning at dawn. A flock of one hundred clones therefore torches 1.8 million POA, while an honest agent perched at the knoll sends distinct signals each round and keeps its lane open.
